tips.text: Run Steel Path Isleweaver for clamps; 15 clamps in 8 to 12 minutes as your own Warframe, so a bad loadout roll does not matter.
On a Steel Path Duviri Experience, clear all three optional Undercroft portals for 24 clamps in about 20 minutes.
Run normal-mode Duviri unless you want the arcanes and Steel Essence; 10 clamps in 10 to 15 minutes beats 15 in about 30.
Stay out of the Orowyrm's head line and shoot its orbs for a speed boost; in phase two skip the Kaithe and kill wyrmlings from the arena edge.
Bring Titania or Zephyr to end the Orowyrm's flight phase in seconds.
Do the non-combat decree objectives first, like feeding the Maw; the decrees carry a weak loadout and Maw feeding drops the Nacreous Pebble.
Use electric damage on the Isleweaver duet boss; it is weak to it.
Players call Pathos Clamps the most annoying grind, but Edun alone is only three or four runs.
Get Syam first if you can; it makes every later Duviri clamp run faster.
